name: Doubledome SEO Meta Updater
author: doubledome

sections.description:
Doubledome SEO Meta Updater Plugin is designed to help website owners improve their on-page SEO. It offers a wide range of tools to optimize metadata, enhance visibility in search engines.

Doubledome SEO Meta Updater Plugin is ideal for bloggers, businesses, and developers looking to boost their website’s search engine rankings and maintain SEO best practices. Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, Doubledome SEO Meta Updater makes SEO simple and effective.

While this plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Yoast, it has been built specifically to work with Yoast SEO metadata fields. You can bulk-edit metadata in a spreadsheet editor and re-import it — saving time and effort.

1. Export SEO Meta Data to CSV

  • One-click export of all indexed content:
    • Post URL
    • Post ID
    • Post Type
    • SEO Title
    • Meta Description
    • Focus Keyword (Primary)
    • Canonical URL
  • Supports:
    • Posts, Pages, Custom Post Types (automatically included)
    • Published status
  • Output: Clean CSV file with one row per post/page.

2. Import SEO Meta Data from CSV

  • Upload CSV with matching format.
  • Fields are automatically matched based on column headers.
  • Each row updates SEO metadata based on Post ID or URL.
  • Skips entries that don’t match existing content.

3. Basic Safeguards

  • Permission checks (Admin only)
  • CSV file validation
  • Warning before overwriting existing meta fields

New! Pro Version Now Available

Take your SEO workflow to the next level with the DoubleDome SEO Meta Updater – Pro Version.
A one-time $19 purchase — no subscriptions, no auto-renew.

Pro Features Include:

  • Bulk Editing Across Your Entire Site
    Update SEO titles & descriptions for all post types instantly.
  • CSV Import & Export
    Export your site’s meta data, make updates in bulk, and import changes with one click. Perfect for SEO teams and agencies.
  • Live Character-Count Guidance
    Ensure your meta titles & descriptions stay within recommended length for Google.
  • Advanced Page Filtering & Sorting
    Quickly find and fix missing meta tags, outdated descriptions, duplicates, and more.
  • Faster, Smoother Workflow<br / Inline AJAX editing means no page reloads — update SEO fields instantly.
  • One-Time Fee
    No recurring billing. Pro includes all future updates.

Upgrade to Pro anytime from inside the plugin or at:
https://www.doubledome.com/doubledome-seo-meta-updater-plugin/

Free Version Features

The free version includes essential tools for quick SEO cleanup:

  • View all titles & meta descriptions in a single dashboard
  • Bulk update for Pages, Posts and Custom Post Type
  • Inline editing without opening each page
  • Works with Yoast SEO plugin
  • Lightweight, fast, and bloat-free

Why We Built This Plugin

As a digital marketing agency managing hundreds of WordPress sites, we needed a simple way to:

  • Identify missing or duplicate meta data
  • Update large volumes of SEO meta quickly
  • Improve on-page SEO without spending hours clicking through pages

This plugin solves real-world SEO maintenance problems — and now with the Pro Version, it’s powerful enough for agencies and enterprise-level sites.

Perfect For

  • Website owners
  • SEO professionals
  • WordPress developers
  • Freelancers & agencies
  • Marketing teams managing large content libraries

Upgrade to Pro

Want bulk editing, CSV import/export, advanced filters, and faster workflows?
Unlock the full SEO management suite for only $19:
https://www.doubledome.com/doubledome-seo-meta-updater-plugin/

Support

Do you have questions or issues with Doubledome SEO Meta Updater by DoubleDome Digital Marketing Setup? Please send an email to pluginsupport@doubledome.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire doubledome-seo-meta-updater folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Yoast SEO?

Yes, the plugin is built specifically to read and write the same metadata fields used by Yoast SEO. However, it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Yoast BV.

Can I use this with Rank Math or All in One SEO?

Currently, the plugin focuses on Yoast SEO fields. Support for other plugins may be added in future versions.

What WordPress version is this Plugin compatible with?

  • Doubledome SEO Meta Updater Plugin is compatible from WordPress 5.3 to 6.8.1

Is it compatible with Astra theme?

  • Yes, Doubledome SEO Meta Updater Plugin is compatible with Astra theme.
